title: Amazon MSK Kafka Cluster Setup
description: Provision and configure Amazon MSK cluster as NiFi real-time flow replacement.

steps.action: Create MSK cluster: 3 broker nodes (kafka.m5.large), Kafka 3.6.x, in private subnets across 3 AZs, TLS encryption, SASL/SCRAM auth
steps.verify: Cluster state = ACTIVE; GetBootstrapBrokers returns TLS endpoints

steps.action: Create MSK configuration: set auto.create.topics.enable=false, log.retention.hours=168, min.insync.replicas=2
steps.verify: aws kafka list-configurations shows configuration ACTIVE; cluster uses this config

steps.action: Create topics for each NiFi flow: kafka-topics.sh --create --topic analytics-events --partitions 6 --replication-factor 3
steps.verify: kafka-topics.sh --list shows all expected topics with correct partition/replication settings

steps.action: Create MSK Connect connector or Glue Streaming job to consume from MSK and write to Aurora/OpenSearch/S3
steps.verify: Connector/job running; consumer group lag < 1000 messages; output appears in target
